text.en: This Act may be cited as the Registration of Guests Short title Act.

(1) Any Keeper of any specified premises who(a) fails to enter or cause to be entered in the register any particulars which he is required by this Act to enter or cause to be entered therein; or

(b) fails to furnish to the nearest Police Station any return which he is required by this Act to furnish; or

(c) fails to produce any register which is required to be made available or to be open for in-- spection under subsection (3) of section 3, or obstructs any police officer or registration officer when such officer or person is exercising his functions under this Act, shall be guilty of an offence: of $8,000 and one year imprisonment.

(2) Any person who -

(a) knowingly or recklessly makes, or causes or to be made in any register or in any return any statement which is false in a material particular; or

(b) without the approval of the registration officer, wilfully destroys, or mutilates or obliterates anything in any register; or

(c) fails to furnish any information in his possesis demanded from him under 4) of section 3, shall be guilty of an offence: Penalty, a fine of $8,000 and one year imprisonment.

(3) Any person required to be registered under who the of section 3(2) shall be guilty of an offence: Penalty, a fine of one year imprisonment.

His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan in Council may make rules for carrying into effect the proviof this Act and, in particular and without prejudice to the generality of the foregoing, such rules may(a) provide for anything which may be preunder this Act, and
